children: David Stinnett, a Director, reported a purchase of Common Stock on 2026-09-16. The filing shows a weighted average purchase price of $37.3203 per share. The total purchase amount was $1,007,648 for 27,000 shares. After the transaction, Stinnett directly beneficially owned 3,530,395 shares of Common Stock. The filing includes a footnote stating the reported price is a weighted average of multiple purchases at prices ranging from $36.99 to $37.52 and that detailed allocation by price will be provided upon request.
